summary: community.general deprecates the empty string value for opkg force and the RedfishUtils._init_session() method.
questions: Can I still pass force: '' to opkg?

answer_card.title: opkg force deprecation
answer_card.answer_md:
- `opkg`: the value `""` for `force` is deprecated.
- `RedfishUtils._init_session()` in redfish_utils is deprecated.
